notes: Pack updates: the Installed tab now checks your packs against stepmaniaonline.net and marks the ones SMO has a newer version of. Start on one shows exactly which files changed and why, and downloads only those instead of the whole pack. Charts are compared by their GrooveStats hashes, so an SMO resync or a fixed credit is not counted as an update; your sync is kept on every song an update touches, and a song SMO only renamed is not downloaded a second time.
